verdict.rationale: Washington ESD runs online employer portals (eServices, EAMS behind SecureAccess Washington), so whether those services can be delegated to an agent via scoped credentials is a fair question. The evidence shows no API at all: every OpenAPI probe returned 404, and the transactional host redirects all keyless requests to a human login. The note that firms representing employers can use eServices is an adjacent delegation feature, not scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit.
